review.tagline: Multi-agent orchestration, memory and MCP tools layered on Claude Code and Codex
review.summary: Ruflo wraps Claude Code and Codex with a harness: swarm coordination, vector-backed memory, hooks that route tasks, and an MCP server. It installs either as Claude Code plugins (35 listed) or via `npx ruflo init`, which adds 98 agents, 60+ commands, 30 skills and a daemon. A console (Claude Code plugin or `npx ruflo tui`) shows agents, cost and missions.
review.audience: Claude Code and Codex users who want swarms, memory and hooks on top
strengths: Two install paths: zero-file Claude Code plugins or full CLI init with hooks and daemon
Exposes an MCP server, so Codex and other MCP clients can use it
Standalone terminal UI runs without Claude Code (`npx ruflo tui`)
Console Claude-control defaults to read + ask, with confirmation for spending and destructive actions
weaknesses: Large surface (314 MCP tools, 26 CLI commands, 35 plugins) is hard to audit
Plugin path gives only a subset; full loop needs the CLI install that writes files into the repo
Mods are not sandboxed and run with your account's permissions
Hook and console support depends on client; Claude Code 2.1.287 or later required for plugins
needs: Needs Node.js/npx, Claude Code or Codex
